core.role: Full Stack PHP Developer, Magento Specialist
core.summary: Full Stack Developer with over 10 years of experience in PHP and Magento. Specialist in e-commerce, evolutionary and corrective maintenance, Clean Code & PSR standards, and collaborative work in globally distributed agile teams.
core.profile: With over a decade of web application development, I have specialized in Magento 2, leading migrations, complex integrations (ERP, Google Shopping, Odoo), and scalable architectures following PSR and MVVM. I have worked with clients in Argentina, Peru, Canada and Venezuela, delivering custom modules, REST/GraphQL APIs and performance optimizations. My approach combines solid backend, dynamic frontend, and DevOps mindset to ensure quality, maintainability, and measurable results in every delivery.

expData.summary: Custom module development under PSR/MVVM. REST/GraphQL integration with continuous unit testing and evolutionary/corrective maintenance.
points: Developed custom modules from scratch following PSR standards and MVVM pattern with scalable architecture.
Executed evolutionary and corrective maintenance via Plugins, Preferences and admin panel configurations.
Implemented backend/frontend components: Repositories, Search Criteria, REST/GraphQL, Observers, Cron Jobs, Controllers, UI Components, Knockout.js and LESS.
PHPUnit unit testing with continuous validation and increased coverage.
Scrum workflow, Confluence/Jira documentation, Bitbucket version control with code reviews.
Base modules for bidirectional sync with Odoo and external ERPs.

expData.summary: Massive catalog sync, ERP/Google Shopping integration and critical performance optimization with Full Page Cache.
points: Synchronized massive catalogs integrating ERP and Google Shopping via Shipping/Payment modules consuming external APIs.
Built full-stack modules with Plugins, Observers, Webhooks, Cron Jobs and Preferences; import/export and URL/catalog management with optimized queries.
Led performance optimization on Checkout, Catalog Product View and Product Search implementing advanced FPC strategies.
Refactored legacy modules removing Object Manager anti-pattern and optimizing redundant queries following Clean Code/PSR.
Documented architecture in Confluence and delivered internal courses for knowledge transfer.

expData.summary: Bidirectional Magento 2 ↔ Odoo integration. REST/GraphQL API schemas and custom EAV models design.
points: Built bidirectional integration between Magento 2 and Odoo ensuring commercial information consistency.
Designed REST/GraphQL schemas guaranteeing interoperability, security and scalability.
Implemented custom EAV models optimizing MySQL structure.
Built modules for Custom ProductTypes and async webhooks for automatic order updates.
Backend grids with sales reports and Excel export; centralized documentation in Confluence.

expData.summary: Led M1→M2 migration, logistics integrations development and Linode DevOps administration.
points: Led Magento 1 → Magento 2 migration designing clean architecture following PSR and MVVM.
Built logistics modules (FlagShip, Detrack) and custom payment gateways via REST APIs.
Internal Laravel 5.6 + AngularJS system for multi-store management connected to Magento via API.
Administered Linode (CentOS) infrastructure: PHP-FPM, Varnish, Elasticsearch and SSL via console.
Built landing pages/catalogs from Figma using native Magento 2 components.

expData.summary: Custom CRM development, REST integrations with WordPress and Linux infrastructure optimization.
points: Custom CRM in Vanilla PHP (PSR/MVC) + MySQL + AngularJS automating client management.
Standalone Laravel 4 certificate validation app integrated via JSON API with corporate WordPress site.
Optimized local servers and web hosting with Linux tuning and preventive maintenance.
Documented systems administration and onboarding guides; GitHub version control per project.

expData.summary: Profit Plus implementation, Excel/MSSQL migration and billing APIs with WordPress modules.
points: Led implementation of Profit Plus Administrative, Accounting and HR systems.
Custom Vanilla PHP solution migrating Excel sheets and MSSQL environments to update Profit Plus inventories/products.
Billing API in PHP/MySQL receiving JSON and generating web reports.
Built custom WordPress modules and kept websites secure and updated.

expData.summary: WordPress administration, Linux maintenance and PHP/MySQL LAN document management tools.
points: Administered website and built custom modules in WordPress.
Local Linux server maintenance.
PHP/MySQL application to organize projects/documents accessible via LAN network.
